title: Rate Book Irrigation Guarantee Provision — Minimum Rate per kVA for the Electric Service by Rate Schedule Seasonal Minimum
content:
**Provision.** The seasonal minimum guaranteed by an irrigation account of Electric Service by Rate Schedule is figured at a minimum rate per kVA chosen from the account's tenure, its late payment history, and the member's line extension under Line Extensions and New Service Construction:

| Account and member records | Minimum rate per kVA |
|---|---|
| Connected 120 whole months or more before the current date, with no late payment charge dated in the twelve whole months before the current date | $20.50 |
| Connected less than 36 whole months before the current date, and the member's Irrigation Well Extension line project is energized or closed — the extension having been built on a revenue-multiple allowance that the minimum stands behind | $25.00 |
| Any other account | The schedule's annual minimum per kVA ($22.80 on Schedule IR Irrigation Service) |

**How the rate is used.** The guaranteed minimum is the minimum rate per kVA so chosen multiplied by the kVA on which the minimum is measured and by the portion of the year guaranteed, the three applied together and the product rounded once to the cent.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Whole months since connection | Late payment charges in the twelve months | Irrigation Well Extension project | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 120 | None | — | $20.50 |
| 119 | None | — | $22.80 |
| 150 | One | — | $22.80 |
| 35 | — | Energized | $25.00 |
| 36 | — | Energized | $22.80 |
| 20 | — | Under construction, not yet energized | $22.80 |

### Point of reading

- The extension read is the member's own line extension project of the Irrigation Well Extension type, by its status.
